a.text: As a dream, as a fantasy. As a bubble, as a shadow. All that is false, all is as real.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Please, I'm begging you!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: The merchant is offering a fortune to anyone who saves his daughter! Please, doctor, I'll do anything!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: A Catastrophe is coming to the city my family lives in, and they're trapped... I can't bear the thought of leaving them there!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I know it's asking a lot after you saved my life, and I know you don't want to come down from the mountains, but I'm at my wit's end...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I'll only use the money to get my family out of there! I won't use it for anything else!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Please, this means everything to me! I swear to the heavens that I won't tell anyone! Let my flesh rot off my body if I break my vow!
It worked! It worked! Thank you! Thank you so much! I swear to the heavens that I'll repay your kindness! Let my flesh rot off my body if I break my vow!
Oh, mother... Here, drink up, it'll make you better.
We're out of medicine? Don't worry, we have Dr. Nine-Colored Deer here!
We haven't been able to contact the outside for days. Is there any other way?
More and more people are dying! I thought Nine-Colored Deer was supposed to save them!
Something's not right with her... Where did she come from? Why doesn't she charge any money? Don't tell me she's...?
She only stayed behind to advertise her medicine and gain our trust!
Look at her Originium Arts! She was the one who brought down the Catastrophe!
Elafia! Bringer of evil! Get out! Get out!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I thought I could earn their trust by saving their lives.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I thought we could coexist in peace as long as I healed them, and showed them love.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: But is that true?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Go.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Doctor!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: You should not have come to me. I want nothing more to do with the world outside these mountains.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Go, and do not return.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I-I understand. I was foolish.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I-I'll try to think of something else... I'm sorry for bothering you.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Hello?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Ah, I knew you'd show up. Thank you for coming so late.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: How is the merchant's daughter?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: She's here in the clinic. It's not clear what afflicts her, but she's getting weaker by the day. She's able to eat, but she spends most of the time sleeping. She complains of neck pains, and has had a fever for days.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Her father is extremely anxious. Everyone knows he's looking for the great healer rumored to be living in these parts. I thought it was only a matter of time before you came down.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I have never stood idly by and watched a patient die.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: But I had a visitor today. I'll need to find somewhere else to stay for a few days.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Someone you saved?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: There's always people like that... Why don't they respect your wish to not be disturbed?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It doesn't matter. I'll be more careful.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Well, I'm just glad you're still willing to stay in the area at all.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Thank you, Zishu. Now take me to the child.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: It hurts... It hurts so much...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: This is a rare illness... Not something that I can just whip up a remedy for.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'll be staying here for a couple of days. I want no visitors, other than patients.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Understood. I'll make sure to keep out unwelcome guests.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Mm.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: One more thing. I want you to pass this on to the merchant tomorrow...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: What will people think this time? A cold and merciless Elafia...?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Two mace, half a mace, three mace... Roll these herbs into balls, and take them for eight days.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: It's so bitter...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Would you like another flavor? Flowers perhaps, or tea?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: I like flowers...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Well then... there.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Take a sniff.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: It smells... sweet?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: There, now swallow it. Not bitter at all, is it? It won't hurt so much anymore.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Why is it sweet?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: You were crying because you didn't want to take your medicine, weren't you? It's sweet now, so there's no need to cry.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: And I'll give you some honey once you've had your medicine.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Doctor, you need sleep. You haven't slept in three days!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: No, I need to finish this book first. It's important. I'll have my dinner after I'm done.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: What...? You just had dinner! I had to make you eat it!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Oh, I see... Well, I'll go to bed after I finish this book—

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Go to bed NOW!
Day 2

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: What's up, Wang?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I'm busy! Don't bother me!

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: What's the matter? Still short on money?

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: People like us, we've gotta make it penny by penny, don't we? Wish I was like that rumored doctor who cured the merchant's daughter. Must've gotten a handsome reward.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: ...Doctor?

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: Anyway, I'll leave you to it. It's already been a few days, and you need to get your family back as soon as you can, before anything else happens.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Impossible... But she said...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: The doctor's not that kind of person...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I'll confirm it with my own eyes tonight!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: This one didn't work... This one's no good either; they can't be taken together.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: The last prescription was a little strong for little Ci's constitution... I need to rethink the dosage...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: The side effect of this ingredient is too strong for her. It needs to go...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: She's allergic to this one. I need to find a substitute...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: No, it's not enough... I need more knowledge, to find another way. Time is running out...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: We have the herbs you asked for... Whoa! What happened to your hair?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Oh... Here, look at this, this recipe...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: You keep doing that, I'll fetch a comb.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: These two ingredients don't go well together, but...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: But...oh!

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Whoa!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'm going into the mountains!

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: I guess your hair can wait...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: It's way after dark. Do you really have to go right now?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I could be back by dawn if I hurry. This new medicine should finally do the trick.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: This is a poisonous weed that looks like an edible plant. Better mark it so no one eats it by accident.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I've tried marking immature herbs, but that hasn't worked. Next time, I should move them into the garden.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I hope bugs don't get to them... Never mind, I don't have time for this.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: The sun's already rising. Still no luck...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Was it here? I can't find the marks I left the last time...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Whoa, this is a poisonous plant... Never mind, it can wait. But this is about as high an altitude as the herbs will grow.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: 'It is the color of snow, with a bitter but pure taste. It is found mostly in the clefts of rocks or on cliffs.' On cliffs...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'm exhausted... but I have to get the herb. Ci can't wait...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: The books say you should tie a knot like this... Never thought I'd be using that knowledge like this.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: There! Let's hope this works.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: She's treating the girl?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Didn't she refuse? Didn't she say she didn't want to come down from the mountains?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: ...Why?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: How is she?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Her fever has subsided, she had porridge this morning without throwing up, and the swelling in her neck has gone down somewhat.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Thank goodness.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Why is your hair a different color from ours?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Hmm... Do you like the pattern it makes?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Yes! Daddy said your hair is so beautiful because you're a really good person.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: My daddy's a good person too. Why won't you trust him?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Zishu won't let me or daddy tell anyone that you saved my life.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It's alright.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'm just happy you're alive and well, Ci. You don't need to say or do anything for me.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: But I haven't seen daddy for days. Where'd he go?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I asked your daddy for a favor. Just let him see you happy and healthy when he comes back in a few days, okay?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It's getting late. Come on, lie down and I'll tell you a story.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: A long, long time ago in a forest far, far away...
Two days later

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: *Yawn* Oh, it feels so good to stretch like this...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: *Yawn*...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: You need to rest your eyes after going through an entire roomful of books these past few days. It's a nice day outside. I should let Ci's bedding get some sun too.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: It's nice to see her getting better, isn't it?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Yes, I'll go see if she needs a change of medicine. Let's get her an armchair so she can sit outside.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: And I'll make some tea. Any preferences?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Anything made by you.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Remember to add some sugar for Ci though.

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Sugar in tea? Blasphemy!

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: I want something sweet...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: What a beautiful day... Not a cloud in the sky.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Ci, remember that poem you said you liked? How did it go?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: 'A little sun, and floating cotton, speckles made of porcelain paint.'

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: My name means porcelain, too!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Now, make sure you keep your blanket on, so you don't catch a cold.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Is somebody there?
Open up! Open up!

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Who is it?
Anyone in there?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I know you're there, doctor! I saw you with my own eyes!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: You've been treating that merchant's daughter, haven't you? I thought you didn't care about money.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I believed you, and look what it got me!

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: Who's this doctor you're talking about?

steps.name: Onlooker
steps.text: What's going on here?

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: What nonsense are you on about!?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: What happened...?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I know you're in there, doctor!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: They say they've already evacuated the city, but I haven't heard from my family in days! I have no idea where they are! The Catastrophe, it...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: It's my own fault that I couldn't get the money to save my family! I'm not blaming anyone for that!

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: But do you really take us for fools!?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Did you lie to me because you wanted the money yourself!?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Me? Money?

steps.name: Onlooker
steps.text: My goodness! It's one thing to not offer help, but to lie?

steps.name: Onlooker
steps.text: Who is this doctor? I'm certainly never visiting them!

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: That's right! That's right!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I knew it would come to this.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: (I thought I could earn their trust by saving their lives.)

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: (I thought we could coexist in peace as long as I healed them, and showed them love.)

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: (But is that true?)

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: You're lying! She didn't ask for a single coin! *cough*...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: Hey, you shouldn't be running around!

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: I'm fine... I can't let them bully her!

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: You're all bad people! How could you think... She's not like that...

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Ci...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Thank you, Ci.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'll speak to him.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Showing your face at last, doctor?

steps.name: Passing Villager
steps.text: The door's opening... So who is it?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: Here they come... Wait, Dr. Nine-Colored Deer?

steps.name: Onlooker
steps.text: He was talking about Dr. Nine-Colored Deer? Er...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: I'm an ass! We're all asses! It's Dr. Nine-Colored Deer!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: She's the who saved my life when I was so badly hurt from falling rocks that my family started preparing the funeral!

steps.name: Onlooker
steps.text: Oh, THAT doctor? Wait, who should I believe now?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: S-She told me not to let anyone know! But didn't I tell you? She didn't charge me a single coin, and even gave me a whole bunch of herbs!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Ah... it's you.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: Yes, me! You remember, right?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: You guys hear that? Everything I said was true, every last word! She's not the kind of person who'd lie for money!

steps.name: Enthusiastic Villager
steps.text: You saved my life, doctor! I'm on your side, no matter what anyone else says!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Daddy's back, Ci! But why are you standing out here like that? And what's with all these people?

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: You're back, daddy! A bad guy is bullying the doctor!

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: He said the doctor tricked him and won't save his family...

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Family? You mean the two people from the city?

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: She didn't ask me for any money. She only asked me to fetch those two. They're staying at a nearby inn right now. What's going on?

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Two people from the city... You can't mean...?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I never intended for you to find out.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I wasn't lying when I said I didn't want to be involved with other people.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Really? My family... They're safe?

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: If you mean the woman and child I brought back, yes, they're perfectly safe.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Y-You did this for me, doctor?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I wasn't helping you.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I was just... just...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: You were helping me the whole time...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: But I doubted you... I... I...

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: What have I done... I'm such a fool.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: I... I'm so sorry...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It's alright. I never told you anything.

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Thank you for saving my daughter, doctor. It seems we've caused you more trouble than expected though.

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: I owe you so much, and have more than a few connections... I could put you in touch with one of the big city hospitals, if you like.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: D-Don't go, doctor, I still have to make it up to you!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: No need to worry.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I'm happy right where I am.
Some days later

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: My daughter has made a full recovery, thanks to you. Please accept these medical books as a token of my appreciation.

steps.name: Sickly Child
steps.text: Nine-Colored Deer! Zishu!

steps.name: Merchant
steps.text: Mind your manners, Ci.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It's alright. It's good to see her up and about like this, after being sick for so long.
I thought I could earn their trust by saving their lives.

steps.name: Wounded Villager
steps.text: Thank you so much... I thought I'd be fine after washing the wound, but that plant turned out to be poisonous and my leg started swelling...

steps.name: Clinician
steps.text: You would have lost it if you'd waited any longer!

steps.name: Wounded Villager
steps.text: Thank you so much, doctor. We're so blessed to have you in our village!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Just be careful in the future. Take these pills; they'll cure the toxins from most poisonous plants.
I healed them.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Let's see... I believe I left a mark here, for the herbs on the cliffs?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Good, the bugs haven't gotten to them.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It's almost autumn. I should save some seeds and try planting them myself.
Showed them love.

steps.name: Frisky Kid
steps.text: I got Nine-Colored Deer! I win!

steps.name: Frisky Kid
steps.text: Aw, I want some too!

steps.name: Frisky Kid
steps.text: No, I won, so I get the candy!

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: No need to fight; there's enough for everyone. We'll play again tomorrow, okay?
And we coexisted in peace.

a.text: As a dream, as a fantasy. As a bubble, as a shadow. All that is false, all is as real.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: How was it?

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Has the painting helped you come to terms?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: It is...

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: All is ethereal, like a fleeting dream.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: So, how are things now?

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: I have not seen Zishu in years. I should find her.

steps.name: Nine-Colored Deer
steps.text: But I also have herbs to deliver elsewhere... They should be nearby.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: Already giving yourself more work? Fascinating.

steps.name: Dusk
steps.text: I don't wish to leave this place just yet... When these mountains are covered in flowers, I'll seek you out again. Let's have a drink together.
